name: maxine-studio
description: Convert TTF/OTF fonts to Chyron MAXINE machine fonts and upload them to the unit
author: Joey D'Anna

scripts.predist:mac: node scripts/download-python.mjs darwin arm64 && node scripts/vendor-python-packages.mjs darwin arm64 && node scripts/vendor-emulator.mjs darwin arm64
scripts.predist:win: node scripts/download-python.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/vendor-python-packages.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/vendor-emulator.mjs win32 x64
scripts.predist:linux: node scripts/download-python.mjs linux x64 && node scripts/vendor-python-packages.mjs linux x64 && node scripts/vendor-emulator.mjs linux x64
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && npx wrangler pages deploy dist-web --project-name maxine-emulator --branch main
